author: RainblowDash
quote: Resonance feels like a love letter to old-school JRPGs. Exploring and trying different strategies are genuinely rewarding. Fans of classic Final Fantasy or turn-based adventures will love this one. There are plenty of references, and appearances drawn from across the entire Final Fantasy series including the online games.

author: RainblowDash
quote: I’ve come to appreciate this game more after GTA 6 flopped. The only real issue with GTA V is that its online community can be rough. Otherwise, it’s an amazing game! People sink thousands of hours into it because the experience is THAT good. I might jump back in to wash the taste of 6 out of my mouth and finally enjoy a good session.

author: RainblowDash
quote: There’s a lot more walking and listening to Mags talk than actual gameplay. When the small amount of gameplay does happen it’s really fun. The story suffers, and the two new characters are insufferable. The lore is mostly intact, but they mess up a major detail about Dominique’s brother. There's also a bit of mischaracterization that occurs involving Dominique during a segment in the game. What I’m trying to say is… *Mags coughs*

author: RainblowDash
quote:
A faithful remake with plenty of fun surprises. The new items, scenes, dialogue, boss replay room, and mechanics made it a blast to play. It stays true to the original while adding many of the things fans wanted. 

There are a few minor issues. The removal of the Mario paintings is debatable, and the very pointy noses on several characters threw me off at first. Still, the new art direction and overall style look great. I’m also glad they kept some of the original’s fun bugs, like the duplication glitch with that one specific Gold Skulltula. The “Waddle” scene is still here, and somehow even funnier.

In my opinion, this is one of Nintendo’s first big wins in a long time. I hope they keep it up, and that we see Majora’s Mask or Master Quest DLC in the future.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: RainblowDash
quote: While playing you are given two terrible character experiences: an overwhelmingly bland protagonist, and a thoroughly unlikeable love interest. Nothing is memorable, and the game seems determined to prevent you from having fun at every turn. There are limitations on what you can do to the point where the game will literally stop you from being able to pull a trigger if you are pointing it at certain people in the game. Most of what you are given to do is literal chores, and keeping the woman of the relationship happy who will give you the silent treatment, and walk away from you if you made her mad. It feels like a game made by people who hate the fans of the previous installments. After such a long delay, you’d expect it to be flawless, yet it’s riddled with bugs that make you wonder how they made it into the release. People used to joke that this game would never come out because of the delays. I kind of wish that joke had come true because the wonder of what could have been would have been a better experience than seeing what it's become.
